Consolidating 2 or 3 companies in Excel?

Free template: paste each trial balance, map to one group chart, eliminate intercompany items, get a consolidated P&L + balance sheet with built-in checks.
linkedin:
Small groups often consolidate in a spreadsheet, and the same three things go wrong: accounts that don't map, intercompany items counted twice, and a balance sheet that doesn't balance.

We built a free Excel template for up to three companies:
→ Paste each company's trial balance (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or MYOB export)
→ Map every account to one group chart of accounts
→ Eliminate intercompany sales, fees and balances
→ Get a consolidated P&L and balance sheet, with checks that flag anything that doesn't add up

You can preview the example figures on the page before downloading. It doesn't handle foreign currency, so translate overseas subsidiaries first.
